decision.reason: The active surgeries share one exact native owner/base but own distinct semantic consequences. Promotion must serialize because any applied mutation changes owner custody; semantic independence does not make stale base locks safe.
decision.firstPromotionReason: This artifact is already the canonical convergence of two earlier overlapping heartbeat surgeries, so promoting it first retires the largest known internal patch-order hazard before rebasing independent siblings.
afterFirstPromotion: Rebase patches/try-forever-operational-contact-owner.patch to the new owner blob and re-review its exact diff.
Only after operational-contact readback, rebase patches/try-forever-adam-mode-input-accessibility-owner.patch to the then-current owner blob and re-review.
Do not call any rebased sibling promotion-ready until its new base blob matches authenticated current owner custody.

currentBaseCollisionSet.semanticOwner: heartbeat selection collection + automatic material-transition announcement

supersededStandaloneRule: Earlier heartbeat-selection-only and heartbeat-announcement-only surgeries remain provenance and must not be promoted independently.
